lead.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.8 Live and Extended Thinking
lead.summary: Google's most advanced real-time dialogue models add near-instant visual understanding, background tool execution and automatic language detection across 97 languages. The Extended Thinking variant tops the Speech-to-Speech Quality Index and is available via the Gemini API, Enterprise, Workspace and Search.

top_stories.title: Agility Robotics unveils Digit 5, a humanoid built for safely working beside people
top_stories.summary: Digit 5 adds a new safety architecture for working in close proximity to humans, 50 lb lifts and a 9-minute fast charge; it's the first launch partner for NVIDIA's Halos for Robotics platform with $300M+ in multi-year orders.

top_stories.title: Profound hits unicorn status with $180M Series D for AI search visibility
top_stories.summary: The AEO/GEO platform raised at a $1.8B valuation co-led by Sequoia Capital and Kleiner Perkins, seven months after its last round.

top_stories.title: Factory raises $200M at $5B valuation for autonomous AI coding agents
top_stories.summary: The enterprise software-factory platform tripled its April 2026 value, with Blackstone, Khosla and Sequoia among investors and customers including Nvidia, Adobe and Palo Alto Networks.

top_stories.title: Claude Fable 5.1 tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
top_stories.summary: The model leads the Intelligence Index v4.2 with strong agentic research scores and caching efficiencies, edging OpenAI's latest.

items.title: JustFit: how to serve 200K-token LLM contexts on a 24 GiB laptop
items.summary: An MLX runtime combining compressed KV execution, component residency and state preservation keeps big contexts usable on laptop memory.

items.title: When should LLMs abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for selective risk control
items.summary: A prompt-only framework conditions answer commitment on an explicit check of required information, improving abstention accuracy with no fine-tuning.

items.title: Mo' Models, Mo' Problems: selecting model pools for multi-agent systems
items.summary: Evaluating eight model-selection strategies shows how pool composition affects reasoning performance across a growing field of open models.

items.title: Where should a document live: context, parameters, or latent representations?
items.summary: Comparing three ways to inject new knowledge into LLMs, and their trade-offs on questions outside the training distribution.

items.title: Coupled calibration and learning: fixing teacher bias in LLM distillation
items.summary: A method that keeps distillation from transferring a teacher's systematic bias, under covariate shift and without target-domain reward feedback.

items.title: MiniMax H3 — 33B omni-modal video generation model now live
items.summary: Generates 4-15 second clips up to 2K with native stereo audio, accepting text, image, video and audio context.

items.title: Vidu S2 — real-time interactive spatial video model
items.summary: A new model for real-time, editable and spatially aware video synthesis, with the paper surfacing on Hugging Face.

items.title: Hermes Agent refactors a million-line Python codebase
items.summary: Nous Research ran 1,393 subagents over 19 hours to cut a million-line codebase by ~34 percent.

items.title: SemiAnalysis maps 300+ datacenter moratoriums and finds they barely slow the buildout
items.summary: Only 1,525 MW is directly delayed out of ~20 GW inside restricted boundaries, with +38 GW forecast for US datacenter IT capacity in 2027.

items.title: South Korea's humanoid robots struggle to match Chinese counterparts
items.summary: Awkward motion exposes a widening capability gap between Korea's hardware efforts and China's faster-moving humanoid push.

items.title: Jensen Huang calls Anthropic's AI-pacing antitrust-waiver proposal 'completely unnecessary'
items.summary: The Nvidia CEO argues safety is an engineering problem labs should solve themselves, as frontier-model demand underpins his chip business.

items.title: Tower Semiconductor to showcase silicon photonics for AI infrastructure at ECOC 2026
items.summary: The analog/RF specialty foundry positions its high-volume silicon photonics and SiGe processes for the data-center AI buildout.

items.title: Cognition releases SWE-2 coding model
items.summary: Positioned as 64 percent cheaper than Claude Fable 5.1 for software engineering tasks.

items.title: Perplexity Hybrid Compute splits AI work between cloud and local Mac silicon
items.summary: Cloud handles research while privacy-sensitive tasks stay on-device.

items.title: Creatify Boreal: AI video ads at $0.01 per second
items.summary: The model prices finished video at about $0.05 for a five-second clip, undercutting closed generation models.

items.title: Web Search Agents by Nimble
items.summary: Self-learning agents that automate web research and retrieval via a developer/API-first interface.

items.title: Biom: a visual workspace for the work AI agents produce
items.summary: See and manage agent outputs in one place instead of hunting through logs.

items.title: Italian AI security startup Exein raises $270M at a $1.7B valuation
items.summary: The Rome-born physical AI cybersecurity player, founded by Gianni Cuozzo, is now a unicorn and will fund US and Asia-Pacific expansion.

items.title: Milan approves three-year autonomous driving pilot with Politecnico spinoff Niulinx
items.summary: Robotaxis, shuttles and on-demand transport will be tested, with a commercial launch targeted for 2029 across 60 European cities.

items.title: AIUC raises $40M Series A to underwrite and audit AI agents
items.summary: Led by Ribbit Capital, building the AIUC-1 audit and certification layer with customers including Cursor, ElevenLabs and Harvey.

items.title: TypeSafe AI emerges from stealth with $40M seed for machine-facing models
items.summary: Founded by ex-OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, with the Jev model aimed at fast, low-cost production components.

items.title: Evvy raises $40M Series B for AI-powered women's precision diagnostics
items.summary: The vaginal microbiome platform combines metagenomics and EvvyAI ML across 100k+ patients, led by Catalio Capital.
